body.name: body
body.comment: candlestick body length (include both negative & positive values)

upwick.name: upper wick
upwick.comment: candlestick upper wick length = high - max(open, close)

lowwick.name: lower wick
lowwick.comment: candlestick lower wick length = min(open, close) - low

upwick_rate.name: upper wick rate
upwick_rate.comment: upper wick rate = upper wick / height

lowwick_rate.name: lower wick rate
lowwick_rate.comment: lower wick rate = lower wick / height

clv.name: Close Location Value
clv.comment: clv = 1 if High = Low else ((Close-Low) - (High-Close)) / (High - Low)

wick_imbalance.name: wick imbalance
wick_imbalance.comment: wick imbalance = upper wick - lower wick

fractal_high.name: Fractal High
fractal_high.comment: Fractal high detected with a 5-bar window

fractal_low.name: Fractal Low
fractal_low.comment: Fractal low detected with a 5-bar window

fractal_high_ffill.name: Fractal High Forward-Filled
fractal_high_ffill.comment: Fractal high (5-bar window) forward-filled for signal generation

fractal_low_ffill.name: Fractal Low Forward-Filled
fractal_low_ffill.comment: Fractal low (5-bar window) forward-filled for signal generation

body_abs_sma20.name: 20-Bar Average Absolute Body
body_abs_sma20.comment: 20-bar simple moving average of absolute body length

range_sma20.name: 20-Bar Average Range
range_sma20.comment: 20-bar simple moving average of High minus Low

candle_range_ratio.name: Candle Range Ratio
candle_range_ratio.comment: Absolute body divided by High minus Low

heikin_ashi_open.name: Heikin Ashi Open
heikin_ashi_open.comment: Previous bar Open and Close midpoint

heikin_ashi_bull.name: Heikin Ashi Bull
heikin_ashi_bull.comment: True when heikin_ashi_close is greater than heikin_ashi_open

bullish_high_break_candle.name: Bullish High Break Candle
bullish_high_break_candle.comment: Bullish candle with High above previous High and Close below the bar High by at least 0.1

bearish_low_break_candle.name: Bearish Low Break Candle
bearish_low_break_candle.comment: Bearish candle with Low below previous Low and Close above the bar Low by at least 0.1
